title: Nested model selection protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Nested model selection should complete this objective: Compare competing model families with nested validation. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Understand model-selection bias.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Describe inner tuning and outer evaluation, including computational cost.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for GridSearchCV, cross_val_score, outer and does not run the learner code. Describe inner tuning and outer evaluation, including computational cost.
